title: SSV Silver Gull — Ship Combat
description: Ship-combat systems for the SSV Silver Gull campaign. Full-screen Ship Overview (press S) with a crew-centric multiplayer turn/action tracker and a per-station action console. First station built: Shields / Comms Officer — Allocate Shields (click a side of the ship), Jam/Hail (roll from your 5e sheet or manual), Micro-Adjust (a green secondary shield).
